nom: TULA H2Oasis Instant Skin Reviving Mask

avis.texte: Feels lovely when first applied in a thick layer as it starts to hydrate the skin but then it turns into a sticky mess on my face.

I've been reading comments and most use it during the day. I use it specifically at night, always giving it at least 20 minutes to dry. This way it's not sticky and I think you get more of the product to absorb into your face.
I love all Tula products. Ever since I switched over to Tula for my skin care, my face has never felt better!

I wanted this mask to be soothing and hydrating, but when I put it on it instantly burned my skin so so bad. It was terrifying and painful. This product also appears to be filled with glitter, which is NOT something I want in my skincare. So disappointing as I usually associate Tula with soothing, nourishing products.

Makes my dry, dehydrated, neglected skin feel amazing after a depressive episode. I find that when my skin is in desperate need of hydration it absorbs this product extremely quickly, so I usually put on a second layer after the first absorbs. I can feel a huge difference in my skin after I use this mask! My face always feels so relieved to be hydrated again. I definitely recommend this to anyone who struggles with self care when their mental health is bad. As silly as it sounds, it truly has changed my life. It makes me feel less shame about not taking proper care of my skin when I'm not doing well.

avis.titre: Don't really feel it did anything.
avis.texte: The instructions say to put it on and wait 10 minutes, then wipe it off. If there's a remainder left, just rub it in. I found that all it did was make my skin sticky.
I love how a small amount goes a long way. And I feel nice and fresh after using. This is a product I will but again.
this mask is my favorite. it leaves my skin super soft and really hydrated! will be buying this again when i run out.
ive been using this mask now for a few months on and off. 10/10, product is soo cooling and hydrating. doesnt irritate my skin at all.
It feels so nice in my skin so relaxing and leave the skin soft

I have dry skin with psoriasis. This product didn't trigger my flareups and left my skin feeling hydrated and cool to the touch. I would still put a moisturizer on top of this if you have very dry skin, but on the days when I had no flareups, it would feel more than enough to leave on by itself.
Love this mask! It plumps and smooths my face. Most of the times ive used this all the product is absorbed after the 10 minutes.
This mask is amazing! I love using it to prep my skin before a long day of wearing make up. My skin feels soft and looks plump after using the mask.

I was excited to use this, however this was a big let down. I do not have sensitive skin at all and when I put the mask on my face - it instantly burned. Got red and inflammed. My sister also gave this product a go and irritated her skin as well.
I love this product. The gel texture feels so soothing and light and leave the skin feeling revived.

I'm still deciding how I feel about this mask. I like it, my skin definitely soaked in the moisture and needed it. Skin felt smooth and hydrated after use. I would have preferred a more cream-based formula and this one is gel. I've only used it once so can't update on longer term results

I was skeptical that this product would work that well. I was wrong. I put what I thought was too much on my skin. It cooled for a little bit and then that sensation went away. I lost track of time so at 12 minutes (not the 10 that your instructed) I went to pat off any excess mask. There wasn't any. My skin drank it up. My skin felt amazing for the next couple days. I look forward to using it again next week.
Does what it says! My skin immediately felt refreshed and depuffed. The cooling effect was soo nice too
Definitely a product that is necessary after being in the sun! Hydration at its best!
My skin felt very soft and looks dewy and moisturized after using the mask

avis.titre: I'm in love with this mas
avis.texte: I'm in love with this mask! My skin is always so dry. This makes my face feel so soft and hydrated. It feels nice and cool when you apply it, which feels wonderful.
I love this mask! My skin is always so dry. This makes it feel so soft and hydrated. It also feels nice and cool when you apply it, which feels amazing!
Love this product!! I had irritation and minutes after applying, it calmed down and my skin was glowing! Love the applicator- you don't have to get your hands dirty! Beautiful results!
Feels so good on! It absorbs in the skin really nicely and doesn't leave a film. I feel like I look like a new person the next day!
I LOVE how cold this feels on my skin the whole time it's on! usually facemarks go on cold then turn to body/room temp. this stays cool.
Perfect for my oily skin! I use this every night as a moisturizer! It's transformed my skin!!
Love this product. Put mines in the refrigerator for the instant cold wake up effect. Didnt put on anything else skin looked amazing all day. Natural nourished skin glow

This mask is so hydrating. You put it on, let it sit a couple min then top off with moisturizer. Its like this cooling mask plumps my skin. If skin is sensitive I dont think id suggest because it does gently exfoliate I think.

This product is a strange one. It is immediately rather hydrating, but once it dries down it becomes super rough. It also has a bizarre applicator that makes it difficult to get all the product off the cap. The star ingredient isnt even spoken about in marketing (Arbutin). They failed at creating a hydrating mask formula, they failed at packaging it appropriately, and they failed at marketing it. Just a complete miss
I have only used it once but love it!! My skin soaked up the hydrating formula! There wasn't much to wipe off or rub in. This will be added to my Tula list of products!

This product burned my face the second that it touched my face. Prior to application, I was put off that the consistency is a gel. It felt gross to the touch. Personally, I also disliked that there is a fine glitter material in the mask. The glitter seems unnecessary and doesn't give the feel of a luxurious, moisturizing mask in my opinion. I absolutely returned this product & do not suggest it. I have sensitive skin, this isn't for anyone with delicate skin.

I was very excited to finally try this. When I bought it there were 0 reviews. I have dry and sensitive skin. Unfortunately this just felt like a typical gel moisturizer and not like a mask. My skin sucked it up like it was nothing. Within 5 minutes it didn't even feel like I had put anything on. I returned this. I have plenty of regular moisturizers that perform just as well if not better than this. Especially for this supposed to be a mask.

avis.titre: This mask is amazing! I l
avis.texte: This mask is amazing! I love it! I keep it in the refrigerator and use it every morning after I wash my face!

I noticed most of Tulas products have pearl coloring added………. This product does have a small amount of glitter. I really didnt want to like the product because of that…… but it is SO hydrating. And its so easy.

Ive always been a little turned off by the heavy influencer marketing Tula does, but when I saw a tiktok ad for this product I was attracted to the application and benefits they claimed. I also ran it through my "Acne Safe" app and saw there was one ingredient that wasnt safe for acne proven skin, but i tried it anyway. Ive used it twice and am very happy with the results. It really is like a cold plunge for your face. Its so nice how easy and mess-free it is. I like to put this on before bed and sleep in it. I wake up feeling dewy and hydrated.
I love the smell and the cooling when you first apply this mask. Once it's settled, it becomes almost drying and rough on my face. I wouldnt purchase again.

I LOVE this product! MY skin is super sensitive, so I was expecting a reaction… absolutely none! I can tell where my skin is the most dry, it absorbs quickly. I prefer to take off the mask, gently, with a washcloth. I'm using this about once a week when my skin starts to feel a bit rough and dry. Plus no weird redness after using.
Really love this mask. it feels cooling on the skin and helps with redness.
I love the coldness this adds to the face it's soothing and so easy to use ! I highly recommend!
